Millions of people want to grow their money but don't know where to start. More than 90% of adults don’t access traditional financial advice. That's the gap Plum was built to close.
We're building the proactive money platform that makes it easy for people to smartly and sustainably grow their money. Whether you're stashing the cash for tea and toast in your first home or catching some rays during retirement, we've got your back.
Since 2016, millions of people across 10 European markets have set aside more than £10 billion with Plum. But what we're most excited about is what comes next and the opportunity for our people to help shape it.
We're now going after something even bigger: the £2 trillion+ advised market in the UK and beyond, currently locked behind high fees and complexity. By combining AI-driven financial guidance with the products people actually need, we're building a solution for everyone, not just the wealthy few.
At Plum, you'll be part of a team that's ambitious, curious and driven. We move fast, learn from what doesn't work, challenge the status quo and, most importantly, build something that makes people's lives better. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and that the best work happens when people feel trusted to take ownership, collaborate openly and bring their whole selves to work.
Join nearly 300 Plumsters and be part of a team shaping the future of money!
The Role
You will be joining our Infrastructure squad as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to ensure that Plum’s systems are resilient, secure, scalable, observable and fully capable to support our growth. You will support our Engineering function to use our infrastructure in the most efficient way. You’ll proactively identify areas of improvements and propose initiatives to make the SRE function more streamlined and with reduced overhead.

What you will be doing:

• Operate, secure and scale our infrastructure (GCP, AWS, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis)
• Automate aspects of systems using infrastructure management tools of the trade (we use Terraform)
• Ensure our metrics give an accurate picture of how the system is performing (we use Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana)
• Build and maintain SLIs and SLOs for our infrastructure, and provide a platform for squads to build their own SLOs on top of collected metrics
• Optimize and oversee our CI/CD infrastructure (Github Actions, CircleCI, ArgocD, Argo Workflows), empowering engineering teams with seamless build, test, and deployment automations
• Lead incident response and troubleshoot issues, correcting and improving systems to prevent incidents and grow at scale
• Build, improve and maintain Developer Experience tooling
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering squads, Security, Compliance to set up and improve Standard Operating Procedures

For this role, we'd like to see:

• Working experience of 5+ years as a Site Reliability Engineer, DevOps or in a similar position
• Proficiency in managing cloud infrastructure with tools like Terraform/OpenTofu
• Strong expertise in administration of Kubernetes clusters (preferably GKE)
• Strong expertise in observability (Logging, Monitoring, Tracing)
• Strong experience in scripting and automation
• Experience in Python, ability to navigate large codebases
• Familiarity with Relational Databases (preferably PostgreSQL)
• Passion for improving engineering workflows and developer productivity
• Analytical, troubleshooting attitude
• Proactive approach on problems, able to identify them and propose solutions
• Passion for continuous improvement and challenging the status quo
• Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written)

Good to have

• System design/administration background
• Security awareness with secure-by-default mindset

Plum's Perks

• We're all in this together! Own part of the company through stock options 💷
• Annual training budget
• Private Health & Life Insurance
• Free Plum Premium subscription for yourself and two members of friends & family (worth 360€ in total).
• 25 days holiday a year, excluding public holidays
• Employee referral scheme up to €4000
• Flexible approach to remote working, though we encourage at least 2-3 days a week in our beautiful office in central Athens for optimal collaboration.
• 45 days work from anywhere
• Team breakfast on Tuesdays and team lunch on Thursdays in the office, as well as a plentiful supply of fruit, snacks and coffee.
• 1 day paid leave for volunteering, supporting you giving back to society.
• 2 weeks and 6 weeks paid sabbatical after four and eight years of service respectively.
• Team trip to secret destinations once a year ✈️
• Great office location in the heart of Athens (Syntagma square), with an amazing view!
• A vibe that’s 🦄🌈💯
